source_summary: Ink-wash winter riverscape with bare groves, riverbanks, a small tiled hut, distant birds, feathery central trees, right-side willows, rocks, and sloped foreground terrain. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: upper_sky_flock
motifs.description: Isolate the scattered flock of small dark birds flying across the open upper-left and central sky, keeping only the bird silhouettes and their minimal wing strokes.
must_preserve: irregular flight rhythm across the pale sky

motifs.name: left_winter_grove_slope
motifs.description: Isolate the left-side winter grove standing on the sloping riverbank, including the bare trunks, branching crowns, shaded slope, and low rocks at the bank edge.
must_preserve: layered gray ink trunks fading into mist
low angular rocks at the water edge

motifs.name: distant_river_bend_rocks
motifs.description: Isolate the quiet middle river bend with pale water reserve, soft shorelines, and scattered dark stones and sandbar marks near the center-left.

motifs.name: foreground_hut_willow
motifs.description: Isolate the small foreground hut with tiled roof beneath the drooping willow canopy, including the visible walls, roof grid, hanging branches, and immediate ground beneath it.
must_preserve: foreground ground wash around the hut

motifs.name: central_feathery_twin_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the pair of tall central trees with twisting trunks, exposed roots, sparse upper branches, and dense feathery dark foliage strokes along the trunks.
must_preserve: twisted pale trunks outlined in dark ink
exposed root curves at the base
contrast between wet wash and dry linear strokes

motifs.name: right_willow_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-right grove of slender bare trees and hanging willows, including the interlaced trunks, long vertical willow strands, and light misty background wash behind them.

motifs.name: upper_right_bare_tree
motifs.description: Isolate the tall bare tree at the upper right, including its dark vertical trunk, angular forked limbs, and sparse twig clusters extending toward the image edge.
must_preserve: asymmetrical reach toward the right edge

motifs.name: foreground_right_rocky_slope
motifs.description: Isolate the broad foreground-right rocky slope and path-like ridge with layered gray washes, dark dotted shrub marks, and curving ground contours.
must_preserve: dark dotted shrub accents along the ridge
angular rock-face strokes at far right

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
